community.feedbackNote: Bug, idea, complaint? It goes straight to the developer. Include what you were doing.

tips: Aim down sights (right mouse) for tighter spread. Hip-fire is for close range.
Headshots deal extra damage on every weapon. Aim for the upper body and let recoil climb.
Throw a smoke (Q) to cross an open lane. Enemies can't see through it, and neither can you.
Frags (G) bounce. Cook one off a wall to clear a corner without stepping out.
In Domination, capturing is faster with teammates on the node. A contested node doesn't move.
You heal after a few seconds out of fire. Break line of sight instead of trading at low health.
Reload behind cover. An empty magazine in the open is the most common way to lose a duel.
Crouching (C) steadies your aim, but a crouched player is easy to flank.

patches.title: Domination
notes: New playlist: Domination. Hold relay nodes A, B and C on Relay Yard and Saltline Depot.
Nodes show as rings and light beams on the map and as badges in the score bar.
Bots now go for nodes their team doesn't hold.
Comms screen: patch notes and a feedback form.

patches.title: Static on the line
notes: New front end: separate Play, Loadout, Career, Squad, Intel and Settings screens.
The story so far: the Relay, the Blackout Winter, Aegis Directive vs Ember Syndicate.
You now join only when you press DEPLOY. Esc opens a pause menu.
You spawn facing into the map, not at the wall.
Report players from the scoreboard. Reports are reviewed by a person.
Enemies you can't see are no longer sent to your game (anti-wallhack).

patches.title: Ranks and squads
notes: Levels, weapon levels and unlocks. Daily orders give bonus XP.
Friend codes, recent players and invite links: squads join the same team.
Text chat with a filter, team chat and mute.

patches.title: Saltline Depot
notes: New map: Saltline Depot, a shipping depot at dusk.
Attachments and perks for your loadout.
